recomendacion_rojo: Notify the Flight Medical Officer immediately.

recomendacion_amarillo: Rest for 10 minutes and re-measure. Drink water.
recomendacion_rojo: Notify the Flight Medical Officer immediately.
fuente: NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1; NASA HRP — The Human Body in Space

recomendacion_amarillo: Sit down, relax, and check again in 15 minutes.
recomendacion_rojo: Notify the Flight Medical Officer. Assess additional symptoms.
fuente: NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1; NASA HRP — The Human Body in Space

recomendacion_amarillo: Check cabin environment, hydrate, and recheck in 30 minutes.
recomendacion_rojo: Contact Flight Surgeon on Earth. May indicate infection or environmental issue.
fuente: NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1; NASA HRP — The Human Body in Space

recomendacion_amarillo: Check hydration and nutrition. Re-measure in 1 hour.
recomendacion_rojo: Eat something if low. Notify Earth if high persists.
fuente: NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1; NASA HRP — The Human Body in Space

recomendacion_amarillo: Prioritize rest. Reduce noise and light before sleep.
recomendacion_rojo: Adjust schedule immediately. Request psychological support if needed.
fuente: NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1; NASA HRP — The Human Body in Space

recomendacion_amarillo: Talk to a crewmate, take a break, write in your journal.
recomendacion_rojo: Contact psychological support on Earth immediately.
fuente: NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 1; NASA HRP — The Human Body in Space
